text:
maya: Quick pingI opened a tiny PR to tidy Nebula3B model card. Found three items while reviewing customer feedback: broken benchmark anchor, unclear note about the int8 adapterand an outdated JS SDK example that uses the old token header.

rachel: link? I hit a 404 too when I was writing a how-to.

maya: Performance section -> anchor to '#benchmarks' points to https://docs.redwood.internal/models/nebula3b#perf-bench (404). guessing the anchor name changed during the last doc reflow.

omar: I can fix the anchor and add a redirect. also noticed Benchmarks table still references an old test harness (bench v1). we should note the harness version and seed config.

sasha: I'll update the JS snippet. New pattern is: 
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({});
await client.generate({ model: 'nebula3b', input: 'Hello' });
```
and mention SDK >= 3.1.0 and env var usage.

rachel: compatibility question: does nebula3b:int8-adapter preserve tokenization parity with nebula3b-fp16? customers asked about output differences.

omar: short answer: tokenization identical. adapter changes runtime kernels, not tokenizer. caveat: int8 has sequence-length ceiling around 4096 because the KV layout is reindexed; add a line: "int8-adapter: supported up to 4k tokens; for longer contexts use nebula3b:fp16."

maya: good. also add a note about fallback behavior in Dedicated: routing will prefer fp16 if int8 pool is saturated. small ops detail but helps ops folks.

sasha: for the JS snippet I'll include streaming example with .stream() and an error-handling snippet showing fallback to fp16 variant if the adapter errors.

docs-bot: Draft PR #2068 opened by maya  items: anchor fix, bench harness version, int8 callout, JS snippet update. CI: linkcheck FAILED (1).

rachel: file a quick issue to update the public benchmark permalink too; the old /benchmarks/nebula3b alias was removed last month.

omar: pushed a redirect and updated the anchor in the markdown. PTAL.

docs-bot: PR #2068 updated  linkcheck OK, preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/2068

sasha: pushed JS snippet changes and added note "requires SDK >= 3.1.0". also added a short migration tip: "If you used nebula3b-int8 (legacy tag), switch to nebula3b:int8-adapter and re-run unit tokenization tests."

maya: one more askplease include a bench footnote: test harness bench v2.0, batch policy "continuous" and GPU A10G; p99 numbers from my run (attached) are ~6% lower than the legacy table.

omar: added the bench footnote and pointed to the uploaded nb3b-v2-bench.json in the PR comment.

docs-bot: PR #2068 merged by maya  release note: Nebula3B model card updates (bench anchor & harness version, int8 adapter compatibility note, JS SDK snippet migration guidance).
